title: game.yaml
description: What a game repository tells the platform about itself. The registry entry in the platform repository decides where it is served and whether it may run a relay.

publish.description: The developer's switch. false keeps the site off GitHub Pages and off the hub, whatever the registry says.

description.description: One or two sentences for search engines and the game's page. Facts only: what it is and what is in it.

meta.description: The short line on the hub card, its parts separated by ' · '.

genre.description: Include "Multiplayer" when the game has online play: the game's FAQ says so.

screenshot.description: A PNG in this repository, 1000x525 or 2000x1050. Used for the hub card and as the social card.

label.description: The card link's accessible name, e.g. "Play X, a free co-op raft game".

credit.description: Shown on the card and the game's page, e.g. "made by Eason".

author.description: Who made the game. Required unless the registry marks the game as Andre's.

basedOn.description: Upstream projects this game is built from (structured data isBasedOn).

account.description: required makes the guard send visitors to sign in before the game loads.

install.description: null for a repository with no package.json.

setup.description: Commands run after install and before checks, e.g. ["npx playwright install --with-deps chromium"].

checks.description: Commands that must pass before a deploy, e.g. ["npm run check", "npm test"].

command.description: The build. null publishes `output` as it is.

output.description: The folder to publish, relative to the repository root. "." for a plain static site.

relay.description: A Cloudflare Worker with Durable Objects for online play. The platform writes its wrangler config; the registry must allow it.

migrations.description: Append-only, exactly as wrangler takes them. Never edit or remove a tag that has been deployed.

vars.description: Plain settings. Secrets are never in this file; ask Andre.

watch.description: Paths (with * and **) whose changes mean the relay must be redeployed. Defaults to the folder of `main`, package.json, package-lock.json and game.yaml.

health.description: A path that answers 200 when the relay is up. Checked after every deploy.
